# gander-settings/renovate

> Shareable Renovate presets that automate routine dependency updates behind a quality gate: patch updates (3 days) and minor updates of stable >= 1.0 dependencies (5 days) automerge once every check on the branch is green or skipped (Renovate merges itself, `platformAutomerge: false`, not only required checks), major updates (7 days) and 0.x minors always stay as PRs for review, vulnerability fixes skip the release age, and daily lock file maintenance automerges once CI is green (no release age applies to it).

Usage rules:

- Start `extends` with `github>gander-settings/renovate` (loads `default.json` = `base` + `automerge`). Only `default` and `base` carry the base config; every other preset is a modifier that must be listed after it.
- Reference presets as `github>gander-settings/renovate:<name>`. Parameterised presets: `pin(<dependency>,<version>)`, `before(<package>,<version>)`; parameters are unquoted and comma-separated.
- Presets merge first to last, later ones win; `packageRules` are concatenated. Putting `:disabled` before the base preset does not disable Renovate, because `base` sets `enabled: true`.
- Minimal config: `{"$schema": "https://docs.renovatebot.com/renovate-schema.json", "extends": ["github>gander-settings/renovate"]}`
- Human-readable docs: https://gander-settings.github.io/renovate/

## Docs

- [Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gander-settings/renovate/main/docs/index.md): goal, quick start, base vs modifier presets, preset table
- [How updates flow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gander-settings/renovate/main/docs/how-it-works.md): release age, automerge per update type, lock file maintenance, composer `php` requirement, Merge Confidence, PR layout, and why each option is set
- [Combining presets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gander-settings/renovate/main/docs/combining.md): merge order, parameters, base without automerge
- [PR table columns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gander-settings/renovate/main/docs/pr-columns.md): `prBodyColumns` trial set and Merge Confidence badges

## Presets

- [default](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gander-settings/renovate/main/docs/presets/default.md): `github>gander-settings/renovate`, base + automerge, the usual choice
- [base](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gander-settings/renovate/main/docs/presets/base.md): base config without automerge, option by option
- [automerge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gander-settings/renovate/main/docs/presets/automerge.md): automerge patches, stable (>= 1.0) minors, GitHub Actions pins/digests, daily lock file maintenance and vulnerability fixes; never major or 0.x minor
- [approval](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gander-settings/renovate/main/docs/presets/approval.md): hold every update in the Dependency Dashboard until approved
- [disabled](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gander-settings/renovate/main/docs/presets/disabled.md): turn Renovate off, keep the config
- [legacy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gander-settings/renovate/main/docs/presets/legacy.md): one PR per package with its newest minor
- [pin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gander-settings/renovate/main/docs/presets/pin.md): `pin(<dependency>,<version>)`, stay on one version line
- [before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gander-settings/renovate/main/docs/presets/before.md): `before(<package>,<version>)`, stay below a version
- [vue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gander-settings/renovate/main/docs/presets/vue.md): keep TypeScript below 7 for vue-tsc
- [docker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gander-settings/renovate/main/docs/presets/docker.md): pin Docker image tags to digests
- [forks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gander-settings/renovate/main/docs/presets/forks.md): run Renovate in forks
